judgment.rationale: The original report describes an update stall and rollback, but later commenters report different versions and symptoms including a locked extension DLL, 0x80070652, eventual success, and removal. These do not establish a single common failure.
evidence: The original author reports a 0.93.x-to-0.96.1 update stall around 65% followed by rollback.
Other comments describe distinct installer failures on other versions, including a locked PowerRename DLL and a 0x80070652 rollback.
One commenter reports a slow but successful update.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask the original author whether their exact failure persists and distinguish it from the other commenters’ cases.

fix_assessment.rationale: The thread now combines materially different installer outcomes; no common PowerToys code fix can be supported until the original author’s failure is isolated. This does not claim each separate failure is fixed.

issue_context.summary: The original PowerToys update stalled and rolled back, while follow-up comments describe several distinct installer behaviors on other machines and versions.

inferences: The thread may aggregate multiple unrelated installer failures.

comment.body: Thanks for the original report. Later comments describe different cases (a locked PowerRename DLL, a 0x80070652 rollback, and an update that eventually completed), so they may not share your failure. Please confirm whether your own update still fails on a current release and which step it stops at: previous-version processing, a file-in-use prompt, or final rollback.
